question: Buddy (buddy.works) already has a compute/buddy record for the Buddy Sandboxes container and VM sandbox offer, resolved by domain buddy.works. This unit adds a ci-cd-runners/buddy record for the hosted CI/CD pipeline service, which is a materially different offer with its own free tier, limits and identity gate. Should these two offers share one provider entity across topics, or remain separate records per topic?
why: The corpus keys one provider to one slug, but the two offers differ in topic, free tier and binding constraint; the integrator decides whether to relate them or keep them separate.
